description: This file 'commit-reach.h' defines function prototypes, enums, and data structures related to commit reachability and merge base computations within a version control system, likely Git. It declares various functions for retrieving merge bases, checking commit relationships, and analyzing commit histories.

methods.name: repo_get_merge_bases
methods.description: Retrieves common ancestors (merge bases) for two commits within a repository.

methods.name: repo_get_merge_bases_many
methods.description: Finds merge bases for multiple commits against a single commit.

methods.name: repo_get_merge_bases_many_dirty
methods.description: Similar to 'repo_get_merge_bases_many' but indicates that object flags after call no longer matter.

methods.name: get_octopus_merge_bases
methods.description: Calculates merge bases for multiple commits, useful for octopus merges.

methods.name: repo_is_descendant_of
methods.description: Checks if a commit is a descendant of another commit.

methods.name: repo_in_merge_bases
methods.description: Checks if a commit is in the merge bases of a reference commit.

methods.name: repo_in_merge_bases_many
methods.description: Checks if a commit is in the merge bases of any in multiple references, with ignore missing commits option.

methods.name: reduce_heads
methods.description: Removes commits from a list that can be reached from others in the list, reducing redundant heads.

methods.name: reduce_heads_replace
methods.description: Replaces the list of commits with its reduced version to avoid memory leaks.

methods.name: ref_newer
methods.description: Compares two object IDs to determine if one is newer than the other.

methods.name: commit_contains
methods.description: Checks if a commit contains certain other commits according to specified filters.

methods.name: can_all_from_reach_with_flag
methods.description: Determines if all commits from a set can reach commits with a specified flag, considering minimum date and generation constraints.

methods.name: can_all_from_reach
methods.description: Checks if all commits from one list can reach another list of commits.

methods.name: get_reachable_subset
methods.description: Returns the subset of commits reachable from one set and also from another, adding a specified flag.

methods.name: ahead_behind
methods.description: Computes ahead/behind counts between commit tips and bases.

methods.name: tips_reachable_from_bases
methods.description: Marks tip commits as reachable from specified base commits.

methods.name: get_branch_base_for_tip
methods.description: Finds the branch base that minimizes differences with a given tip among multiple bases.
